summary.zh: 用对抗式提问检验高管计划与决策
summary.en: Adversarial thinking partner for founder and executive decisions

description.zh: 为创始人和高管提供对抗式的思考伙伴，用于检验计划、处理难下的决定、准备董事会会议或做一次坦诚的复盘。会对备选方案打分并梳理关键干系人。适合需要外部视角而不是附和的时候。
description.en: An adversarial thinking partner for founders and executives: pressure-test a plan, make a dreaded decision, prepare a hard board meeting or run an honest post-mortem. Scores options and maps stakeholders.
